name: Littoral-Hypostyle
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a tidally locked hemisphere.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Surveyors date the ancient alien ruins to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
